# Awesome Directories

> Curated directory aggregator helping indie hackers discover 300+ verified product launch directories for SaaS products.

## Quick Links

- Website: https://awesome-directories.com
- Repository: https://github.com/awesome-directories/awesome-directories
- License: Apache 2.0
- Full Documentation: /llms-full.txt

## Tech Stack

- Framework: Astro.js 5.x (Static Site Generation)
- Interactive Components: Vue.js 3 (Composition API, islands architecture)
- Styling: Tailwind CSS 4.x
- Database: Supabase (PostgreSQL + Auth + Edge Functions)
- Email: Resend API
- Hosting: GitHub Pages

## Project Structure

```
src/
├── pages/           # Astro pages (file-based routing)
├── components/      # Astro (static) + Vue (interactive) components
├── composables/     # Vue Composition API logic
├── content/blog/    # Markdown/MDX blog posts
├── layouts/         # Base HTML layouts
├── lib/             # Supabase clients, utilities
├── stores/          # Nanostores for auth state
└── integrations/    # Custom Astro integrations

supabase/
├── migrations/      # Database schema migrations
├── seeds/           # Seed data (directories.json)
└── functions/       # Edge Functions (Deno runtime)

public/
├── data/            # Generated at build: directories.json, stats.json
└── pagefind/        # Search index (generated)
```

## Key Entry Points

- `src/pages/index.astro` - Home page with directory listing
- `src/pages/directory/[slug].astro` - Dynamic directory detail pages
- `src/pages/blog/[slug].astro` - Blog post pages
- `src/components/DirectoryListContent.vue` - Main filtering/search UI
- `src/composables/useDirectories.js` - Client-side data logic
- `src/lib/supabase-server.js` - Build-time database client
- `src/lib/supabase-client.js` - Runtime database client

## Development

```bash
bun install          # Install dependencies
bun start            # Dev server on localhost:3000
bun run build        # Build static site
bun run preview      # Preview production build
```

## Architecture Pattern

1. **Build-time**: Fetch directories from Supabase → Generate static HTML + JSON
2. **Runtime**: Load `/data/directories.json` for client-side filtering
3. **Interactive**: Vue islands hydrate for filters, auth, favorites
4. **Auth**: Supabase OAuth (Google/GitHub) for user features

## Core Features

- Directory listing with advanced filtering (DR, category, pricing, link type)
- User authentication with favorites and submission tracking
- Directory submission system with admin review workflow
- Blog with Markdown/MDX, search (Pagefind), and comments (Giscus)
- Statistics page with Chart.js visualizations
- Email notifications via Resend (approval, rejection, welcome)

## Database Tables

- `directories` - Main directory listings with SEO metrics
- `user_favorites` - User saved directories
- `pending_directories` - User submissions awaiting review
- `projects` / `project_submissions` - Track submissions per project
- `directory_ratings` / `directory_reviews` - User ratings and comments

## Important Conventions

- Astro components (.astro) for static content
- Vue components (.vue) with `client:load` for interactivity
- Build-time data fetching; runtime for user-specific features
- Mobile-first responsive design
- WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility target
